summary: Inside the dark, soot-black plumbing wall of the hotel, Trinity pulls Cypher free from a tight spot just as a Cop outside opens fire. Bullets punch shafts of light into the darkness. Neo grabs a gun and blasts wildly through the plaster and lath to suppress the firing.

what_changes.before: Passive observer or waiting to move
what_changes.evidence: Neo finds his GUN first and begins BLASTING wildly through the plaster and lath.

event_hint.one_line: The crew is pinned down inside the wall as police fire into the crawlspace.
